verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Bland ships an MCP *server* so external coding agents can manage the Bland account (docs-11/20/27/34/44), which is the reverse of this story. For live tool-calling during calls, Bland's documented mechanism is a custom API/HTTP endpoint integration (docs-4, docs-25), not consuming MCP servers as a tool source for the voice agent itself. No evidence the voice agent can plug in arbitrary MCP servers mid-call to gain toolsets.
